history: I need to get an extension so I don't get into problems when I'm away
Will you be out of state when your inspection expires?
yes
You can apply for an extension. You should also find out if an expired out-of-state inspection is a violation of law in the state you will be in.
what day of the month will my inspection expire?
The inspection will expire the last day of the month punched on the inspection sticker
do you have a list of what will be checked during the inspection?
You can look at the DMV brochure, New York State Vehicle Safety/Emissions Inspection Program for Cars and Light Trucks, it  lists the equipment items checked during a safety inspection.
can you also tell me what to do when an inspection sticker comes off?
You can reattach it to the windshield with clear tape or a small amount of clear adhesive.

raw_query: and what if my vehicle's inspection tag has expired in the last 60 days
history: I moved to New York and registered my vehicle here. Do I need to do an inspection again?
Was your vehicle registered in another state that issues an inspection tag?
Yes
In that case you don't need to be inspected immediately. Your out-of-state inspection remains valid until it expires or for one year after the registration date, whichever comes first.
What if I leave New York and my inspection expires, what should I do?
Wait 14 days for the DMV to process and ship your extension decal. You will need it before returning your vehicle to New York
and which program is in charge of this?

The DMV brochure, New York State Vehicle Safety and Emissions Inspection Program for Automobiles and Light Trucks [3] C-50 lists the items of equipment reviewed during a safety inspection, and a description of the inspection of security
If the inspection tag expires more than 60 days, how much is the fine?
the fine is between $ 50 and $ 100
I need to replace the inspection tag, how do I do it?
You can have your vehicle re-inspected or you can request a replacement sticker using the Request for Replacement Inspection Sticker PDF [8] VS-118 form.

Yes, this does exist and is known as borrower defense to repayment, or borrower defense for short. Ther are sections on the website that go into this aspect further
How do I access notifications regarding the Sweet v. DeVos Lawsuit, are they available to the public?

Notifications regarding the Sweet v. DeVos Lawsuit will be emailed by the US Government in June/July 2020. These notifications will be emailed to borrower defense applicants who are deemed to be potential members of the group of borrowers that this lawsuit applies to. The notifications will inform this group of borrowers that there is a proposed settlement of the lawsuit
Are there questions that you have about these notifications that are not answered on the website?
No, I have gone into this fully yet, but may do so in the near future
What is included under the term borrower defense discharge when related to the term Direct Loan?
We define the term Direct Loan in 34 CFR 685.206 to include Direct Consolidation loans

history: I have reason to believe that I could be eligible for loan forgiveness in relation to my school, can you give me more information on this regard?
This loan forgiveness is known as borrower defense to repayment, or can be known as borrower defense for short. We have extensive information on our website about this
If my program earnings exceed those of the comparison earnings that are carried out by the ED, what happens?
In this case, even if you have filed an approved claim, you will not receive any discharge of your loan until it is associated with Corinthian Colleges, Inc. (CCI)
How does the ED calculate the amount of discharge I am due if my claim is approved?

The ED calculates the amount of discharge by comparing the earnings of those who have completed a similar or same program at a borrower's school median program earnings with the earnings of those who have completed a similar or same program at other schools median comparison earnings
Has the COVID-19 pandemic had any impact on forbearance/stopped collections on any loans that are in default and are awaiting judgment on their borrower defense application?
Yes, this comes under the Automatic Administrative Forbearance and Temporary 0% Interest as a Result of the COVID-19 National Emergency
Is there a list of common questions and answers regarding forbearance/stopped collections status on a loan?

The process involved in applying for borrower defense may place all federal student loans you have into a forbearance status. Any debt collections that may be in force on defaulted loans are stopped pending an ED review of your borrower defense application . Interest will continue to accrue on these loans, regardless of what status they are in
Have you had your application for borrower defense denied or partially approved?

An inspection issued to the previous applicant is invalid.

raw_query: How will I know how much I have left after the interest is calculated?
history: Hello there. My school misled me and I came here to find out if I am eligible for loan forgiveness in that context.
Of course. This type of loan forgiveness is called borrower defense to repayment, sometimes abbreviated to borrower defense.
Great. What happens if I receive a 100% discharge?
In that case you do not receive a separate interest waiver because your entire loan balance, including any interest, is discharged.
Good to know. And who exactly is eligible for this borrower defense?

Under the law, you may be eligible for borrower defense to repayment forgiveness of the federal student loans that you took out to attend a school if that school misled you, or engaged in other misconduct in violation of certain state laws. You may assert borrower defense by demonstrating that the school, through an act or omission, violated state law directly related to your federal student loan or to the educational services for which the loan was provided.
Are you eligible to receive federal student loan forgiveness?
Yes, I am.
In that case you may be able to have all or part of your outstanding federal student loan debt forgiven, and you also may be reimbursed for amounts you have already paid on those loans.
What are you doing to provide help to student loan borrowers during the Covid-19 crisis?

Federal student loan borrowers are automatically being placed in an administrative forbearance, which allows you to temporarily stop making your monthly loan payments. In addition, interest is being temporarily set at 0% on federal student loans.
